messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — Orion Payments procurement asked for a compact assurance packet for their POC: SOC 2 Type II excerpt, ISO 27001 snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation they can retain. They explicitly said no raw vuln details. Need by COB Thursday for their compliance review.

tariq_se: We can assemble a tight bundle. Assets: SOC2_redacted_excerpt.pdf, ISO27001_scan.png, pen-test exec summary (RedTree Security). We'll include a short control diagram for Private/KMS and a one-liner about in-transit encryption.

mira_compliance: I can prepare a compact one-page attestation + index. Quick clarifying Qs: (1) Do they require the pen-test engagement dates in the attestation? (2) Do they need explicit verification that logs are scrubbed of PII? Legal must sign wording. I can draft in ~8 hours.

hao_engineering: Recommend language: `All data in transit is encrypted (TLS1.2+); customer-managed keys never leave the customer's VPC for Private deployments.` For PII: we only include audit logs per customer config and have redaction controls — we can state: `Audit logs do not contain retained customer PII unless configured by the customer.`

alex_sales: Procurement also asked whether Dedicated/reserved capacity pricing for a POC will materially change unit pricing vs hosted — keep it high-level.

sam_legal: Legal prefers: do not claim specific remediation timelines beyond "no unresolved critical findings as of [date]". We'll approve attestation with engagement reference and remediation confirmation. If they request full RedTree report, require NDA + redaction.

mira_compliance: Draft attestation text I'll use:
[Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that an independent penetration test (RedTree Security) covering the inference control plane and associated hosting components was completed on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]. The full report is restricted; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance purposes. The attached architecture diagram documents KMS separation for Private deployments. For POC inquiries regarding pricing, contact your Redwood sales representative.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference	6 Compliance

ticketbot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-5233 assigned to mira_compliance. Due 1977720000.

mira_compliance: I'll stage a compact ZIP with: 1) SOC2_excerpt_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert.jpg, 3) Attestation_draft.pdf (pending Legal), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Private_kms_diagram.svg, 6) Pricing_note.txt, 7) Telemetry_and_pii_line.txt.

hao_engineering: Telemetry/PII line suggestion: `Only aggregated telemetry is processed for performance metrics; audit logs may contain customer-provided identifiers only if the customer enables them and controls retention.`

mira_compliance: Uploaded presigned link (internal, expires 7 days): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-5233/orion-assurance-compact.zip?exp=7d (do not share publicly).

alex_sales: Thanks team — I'll forward link to Orion procurement and confirm whether they need legal countersign before download. If they press for the full report we will route through NDA/redaction. :white_check_mark:
